title: Review docs/design/native-pr-landing.md independently
summary: Write only a new independent review of native-pr-landing.md under docs/design/reviews/, with numbered, severity-rated findings and a verdict. Check it against today's evidence (squash Co-authored-by paragraph burying Athena-Job trailers; one landed job per squash) and the parallel-jobs F1 ordering. The design is not revised; that is a later job.

defaults_applied.how: Review only; one new Markdown file.
Findings cite design lines and label observations with date and method.
Review written for an outside reader.
No email addresses or personal data.
Run cargo test and clippy to confirm docs-consistency checks still pass.

assumptions: Review file is named native-pr-landing-review-N.md following existing naming; no review file for this design exists in the tree, so N is probably 2 (the rejected first review may be absent) or 1.
Today's GitHub evidence is recorded in the review, not asserted as measured by the reviewer unless the reviewer can cite how it was observed.
Existing docs tests may check review files or the requirements map; the new file should not break them.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new review file under docs/design/reviews/ for native-pr-landing has numbered findings, each citing the design section or line and a severity, and ends with a verdict.
The review examines how Athena-Job trailers are found when GitHub's squash appends a Co-authored-by paragraph after them. It labels this as observed on 2026-10-13 and says how it was observed.
The review examines the one-landed-job-per-squash limit: its effect on the chain rule (M30) and on pull requests holding several jobs.
The review checks that the design is placed before the parallel pool, citing F1 in docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md.
Claims keep (read)/(design) labels. Numbers are cited or marked as estimates. No secrets or personal data, including email addresses, appear.
native-pr-landing.md is not revised; the revision is left to a separate job. Only Markdown files are added, and no Rust, governance or records/ path changes.
Run `git status` and `git diff --stat`: only .md files under docs/ are added or changed. Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy`: both pass, so any docs-consistency tests accept the new file.

out_of_scope: Any Rust code, governance file or records/ change
departures: Slightly lower cost and a bit higher acceptance than the reference, because the scope is a single review document with no code.
